title: Contract
description: `.hexagen/contract.json`: what the slice may and may not depend on. A rule is one of two shapes, decided by its `kind`: the prefix kinds `forbid` and `allow-only` carry `from` and `to`, and the `closed` kind carries `except` (the slice is its `from` side, so it has no `from`/`to`). `closed` is the only kind that may carry `except`, and the prefix kinds are the only ones that may carry `from`/`to`. The built-in rule id `unresolved-import` covers an unresolved in-slice specifier. `knownViolations` entries have the shape of the ratchet baseline (tools/arch-linter/src/ratchet-baseline.ts). Mirrors packages/shared/src/types/brownfield/contract.ts.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version. Consumers understand the 1.x line only.

oneOf.description: A prefix rule: `forbid` or `allow-only`, judged on one `from` prefix and one `to` prefix.

A closed rule: the slice is the `from` side, so the rule carries no `from`/`to`; every edge that leaves the slice is denied unless its target is inside the slice or under an `except` prefix. `except` may be empty, which accepts no crossing.

ruleId.description: Must not be a built-in rule id (unresolved-import).

slicePath.description: Repo-relative, case-sensitive. Control characters (U+0000-U+001F, U+007F, U+2028, U+2029) are also refused. A trailing / makes a directory prefix; anything else is an exact file path. `.` and `..` segments, empty segments, absolute paths, backslashes and NUL are refused.
